description:
Several .unwrap() calls exist in production (non-test) code without explanatory comments:

kithd/src/lib.rs:180 — Response::builder().body(...).unwrap() — builder errors are impossible here but unexplained
kithd/src/lib.rs:355 — builder.body(body).unwrap() — same
kithd/src/peer_fetch.rs:215,220 — char::from_digit(...).unwrap() — infallible for 0-15 + radix 16 but no comment

The pattern in lib.rs line 178 uses .expect() correctly ("JmapResponse always serializes") but the chained .unwrap() at line 180 has no comment. Similarly line 355.

Fix: add // SAFETY/INFALLIBLE comments or use .expect("reason") for each of these, or restructure to propagate errors. The peer_fetch.rs case is purely infallible and should have an explanatory comment.
title: Production .unwrap() without justification in kithd/src/
